# Pinned ERC-8412 registry

Unmodified `assets/erc-8412/contracts/PreregisteredCriteria.sol` from
https://github.com/richard7463/ERCs/tree/6ba1149f5c21f80135b79d47e5ca51b71bc33059
(the head of ethereum/ERCs#2002 checked on 2 November 2026).

The source is licensed CC0-1.0, as declared in its SPDX header. The local
CriteriaOrderFixture uses the actual registry; it does not implement the full
8412 off-chain verifier. The test suite verifies the SHA-256 pin before compiling.
